basics.name: James A. Hernandez
basics.label: Lead Product Design Engineer (UX)
basics.summary: Lead UX and product designer specializing in complex enterprise applications, financial services, and regulated environments. Experienced in end-to-end experience design, user research, workflow optimization, and design systems. Collaborates with product leaders, engineers, and stakeholders to align business objectives with user needs. Combines design leadership, front-end expertise, and AI-assisted prototyping to accelerate delivery.
coreStrengths: Front-end Engineering with React and TypeScript

work.name: EthosRisk
highlights: Served as the sole UX and product designer for SightLine, an enterprise platform supporting insurance investigations and medical case management.
Led discovery, workflow analysis, information architecture, and interaction design for case management, scheduling, administration, and client-facing workflows.
Collaborated with product owners and engineers to modernize legacy interfaces and develop reusable UI patterns.
Created functional React and TypeScript prototypes using Mantine and Storybook; applied AI-assisted tools to speed design exploration and prototyping.

work.name: Kforce (USAA / Noblr)
highlights: Served as the sole product designer for Noblr, an auto insurance company acquired by USAA.
Designed mobile and responsive web experiences for policy purchases, claims, policy changes, driver and vehicle management, and account security.
Produced user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes, and reusable components in Figma and Sketch in collaboration with product and engineering teams.

work.name: Outside Analytics
highlights: Developed React and TypeScript interfaces for a geospatial application visualizing satellite data and paths on a global map.
Implemented map controls, layers, path visibility, and saved locations using REST and Socket.IO integrations.
Combined front-end development and interface design for complex data visualization workflows.

work.name: Insight Global
highlights: Designed and developed web and mobile experiences for U.S. Department of Education student loan services, including loan simulations and forgiveness applications.
Partnered with UX teams to translate designs into responsive interfaces using Angular, Bootstrap, and REST APIs.
Modernized a U.S. Air Force promotions application, replacing its legacy Silverlight interface with React and Redux.
Improved usability through reusable UI components and supported team development practices, including Git version control.

work.name: Ampcus Inc
highlights: Led UX design for Randolph-Brooks Federal Credit Union, from requirements gathering and research through implementation.
Analyzed usage metrics and user feedback to prioritize design improvements.
Created wireframes, evaluated user flows, and designed landing-page interfaces.
Developed reusable front-end templates and interfaces using Sass and JavaScript.

work.name: Visage Collaborative, Inc.
work.position: Founding User Experience Designer and Developer
highlights: Co-founded a small design and development consultancy and led design engagements for early clients.
Managed web application projects and contributed as a lead developer.
Maintained production hosting environments on AWS and Azure.
Led client engagement and business operations, including contractor utilization and accounting.

work.name: USAA
highlights: Designed web and mobile experiences, including an internal Enterprise Correspondence Tool for postal and digital member communications.
Created functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript wireframes and collaborated with Java developers.
Worked on mobile app interfaces and implemented A/B tests.

references.name: óscar gutiérrez jr.
references.reference: James was valued as a user interface designer at USAA.  He was constantly researching best design and development practices in XHTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  He would frequently skip lunch to read books such as PPK on JavaScript, among others.  James will be missed.
